releases.title: Law & Order
releases.synopsis: In cases ripped from the headlines, police investigate serious and often deadly crimes, weighing the evidence and questioning the suspects until someone is taken into custody. The district attorney's office then builds a case to convict the perpetrator by proving the person guilty beyond a reasonable doubt. Working together, these expert teams navigate all sides of the complex criminal justice system to make New York a safer place.

releases.title: Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen
releases.synopsis: Bravo network executive Andy Cohen discusses pop culture topics with celebrities and reality show personalities.

releases.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
releases.synopsis: In the criminal justice system, sexually-based offenses are considered especially heinous. In New York City, the dedicated detectives who investigate these vicious felonies are members of an elite squad known as the Special Victims Unit. These are their stories.

releases.title: Grey's Anatomy
releases.synopsis: Follows the personal and professional lives of a group of doctors at Seattle's Grey Sloan Memorial Hospital.

releases.title: Late Night with Seth Meyers
releases.synopsis: Seth Meyers, who is "Saturday Night Live's" longest serving anchor on the show's wildly popular "Weekend Update," takes over as host of NBC's "Late Night" — home to A-list celebrity guests, memorable comedy and the best in musical talent. As the Emmy Award-winning head writer for "SNL," Meyers has established a reputation for sharp wit and perfectly timed comedy, and has gained fame for his spot-on jokes and satire. Meyers takes his departure from "SNL" to his new post at "Late Night," as Jimmy Fallon moves to "The Tonight Show".

metadata.episode_name: Quinta Brunson, Stephen Graham, Owen Thiele

releases.title: The Daily Show
releases.synopsis: The World's Fakest News Team tackle the biggest stories in news, politics and pop culture.

releases.title: Binnelanders
releases.synopsis: A South African Afrikaans soap opera. It is set in and around the fictional private hospital, Binneland Kliniek, in Pretoria, and the storyline follows the trials, trauma and tribulations of the staff and patients of the hospital.

releases.title: Tomorrow Is Ours
releases.synopsis: The story revolves around the people of Sète, France. Their lives are punctuated by family rivalries, romance and scenes from daily life, but also by plots involving police investigations, secrets and betrayals.

releases.title: Ici tout commence
releases.synopsis: This television drama series is centered around the prestigious culinary school of renowned chef Auguste Armand. The show follows the lives of students and staff as they navigate the challenges and pressures of the culinary world—delving into their personal and professional lives, revealing secrets, rivalries, and complex relationships.

releases.title: American Horror Story
releases.synopsis: An anthology horror drama series centering on different characters and locations, including a house with a murderous past, an asylum, a witch coven, a freak show, a hotel, a farmhouse in Roanoke, a cult, the apocalypse and a summer camp.

releases.title: EastEnders
releases.synopsis: The everyday lives of working-class residents of Albert Square, a traditional Victorian square of terrace houses surrounding a park in the East End of London's Walford borough.

releases.title: Chronicles of the Sun
releases.synopsis: Claire is surprised when she gets arrested for the murder of her childhood friend after she returns to Montpellier.

releases.title: Good Mythical Morning
releases.synopsis: Two "Internetainers" (Rhett & Link) go far out and do the weirdest things, giving you a daily dose of casual comedy every Monday-Friday.

Explore the high-pressure experiences of police officers, paramedics and firefighters who are thrust into the most frightening, shocking and heart-stopping situations. These emergency responders must try to balance saving those who are at their most vulnerable with solving the problems in their own lives.

releases.title: The View
releases.synopsis: ABC Daytime's morning chatfest, currently featuring Whoopi Goldberg, Joy Behar, Sunny Hostin, Sara Haines, Alyssa Farah Griffin, and Ana Navarro discussing the most exciting events of the day. Hot topics in the news, the best experts in their field, celebrity interviews and general entertainment are all part of The View.

releases.title: Jeopardy!
releases.synopsis: America's favorite quiz show where contestants are presented with general knowledge clues in the form of answers, and must phrase their responses in question form.

releases.title: LIVE with Kelly and Mark
releases.synopsis: A morning talk show with A-list celebrity guests, top-notch performances and one-of-a-kind segments that are unrivaled on daytime television, plus spontaneous, hilarious and unpredictable talk.

releases.title: El hormiguero
releases.synopsis: El Hormiguero is a Spanish television program with a live audience focusing on comedy, science, and politics running since September 2006. It is hosted and produced by screenwriter Pablo Motos. The show aired on Spain's Cuatro channel from launch until June 2011 and is now broadcast on Antena 3. Recurring guests on the show include Luis Piedrahita, Raquel Martos, Marron & "The Man in Black", and puppet ants Trancas and Barrancas. It has proved a ratings success, and has expanded from a weekly 120-minute show to a daily 40-minute show in its third season, which began on September 17, 2007. The show won the Entertainment prize at the 2009 Rose d'Or ceremony.

releases.title: Quotidien
releases.synopsis: Quotidien (nicknamed "The French Show with the Good Lighting" abroad) is a French daily infotainment television program broadcast in the early evening on TMC since September 12, 2016. The show is hosted by Yann Barthès and produced by Bangumi. It consists of segments and reports produced by the team of commentators and journalists surrounding Yann Barthès and features daily guests including newsmakers, intellectuals, politicians, and French and international celebrities.

releases.title: Eternally Yours
releases.synopsis: Eternally Yours is a family comedy centered around Charles and Liz - a vampire couple whose once-passionate romance has devolved into a pulseless marriage after 500 years together. Living in present-day Seattle with their oddball coven, they've settled into an eternal rut - until their daughter's earnest human boyfriend unexpectedly enters their lives and forces them to confront whether their love can survive forever... or if forever is a life sentence.

releases.title: War
releases.synopsis: War follows two of London's most prestigious rival firms – Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne – as they go head-to-head in the divorce case of the century. Each side is certain they'll win. But as the case spirals and loyalties fracture, reputations are on the line, and everyone's playing to win.

releases.title: Cupertino
releases.synopsis: A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

releases.title: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon
releases.synopsis: Emmy Award and Grammy Award winner Jimmy Fallon brought NBC's "The Tonight Show" back to its New York origins when he launched The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon from Rockefeller Center. Fallon puts his own stamp on the storied NBC late-night franchise with his unique comedic wit, on-point pop culture awareness, welcoming style and impeccable taste in music with the award-winning house band, The Roots.

releases.title: The Celebrity Traitors
releases.synopsis: Claudia Winkleman has opened the castle doors to an all-star cast who are ready to play the ultimate game of deceit and betrayal.The celebrities will play the ultimate game of detection, backstabbing and trust, in the hope of winning a cash prize up to £100,000 for a charity of their choice.

releases.title: All Creatures Great and Small
releases.synopsis: All Creatures Great and Small chronicles the adventures of a young country veterinarian.

releases.title: Blue Skies
releases.synopsis: Blue Skies is an all-new procedural series blending mystery, action, and emotional storytelling, centered on the powerful bond between a detective and her canine companion.Set in the stunning Crystal Ridge National Park, the series follows former military police officer Jodi Larsen as she returns to her hometown to serve as a criminal investigator for the National Park Police. As Jodi protects the park and its visitors from both natural and human threats, she navigates a new team, personal loss, and an unexpected partnership with Blue, a mischievous stray Labrador whose instincts prove invaluable in solving cases.The canine, Blue, a golden Labrador Retriever is played by three brothers, River, Comet and Canyon. River is considered the "star" of the three.

releases.title: Special Forces: World's Toughest Test
releases.synopsis: Household names endure some of the harshest, most grueling challenges from the playbook of the actual Special Forces selection process. There are no votes, and no eliminations – just survival. These celebrities, who are so used to being in the spotlight, quickly learn the meaning of "no guts, no glory" – and no glam.

releases.title: Ask This Old House
releases.synopsis: The crew at This Old House take on some pretty big projects, which means they can only work on one or two houses a year. But homeowners have a virtual truckload of questions on smaller projects, and the TOH crew is ready to answer. Ask This Old House solves the steady stream of home improvement problems faced by viewers - and the crew even makes house calls!

releases.title: After the First 48
releases.synopsis: After the First 48 revisits some of the most powerful cases originally featured on the First 48 and features exclusive interviews with detectives, prosecutors, defense attorneys, and families of victims. After the First 48 takes viewers through the dramatic and emotional inside story; from the investigation, to the murder trial itself, the verdict and beyond.

releases.title: Watch What Happens Live
releases.synopsis: Watch What Happens Live is an interactive series hosted by Bravo programming executive Andy Cohen, Bravo's Senior Vice President of Original Programming and Development, is best known to viewers as the host of the network's often explosive Watch What Happens reunion specials. Watch What Happens originally debuted as a live online show on www.bravotv.com. Watch What Happens welcomes guests from some of the cable network's most popular series, as well as other entertainment stars, to chat about pop culture and celebrities in the news!

releases.title: Big Brother
releases.synopsis: Housemates live under 24-hour surveillance as they attempt to avoid eviction from the Big Brother house with the most unpopular housemates facing a public vote. The iconic house has had a fresh lick of paint and is ready to welcome a brand-new cast of housemates from all walks of life as they take up residence in the Big Brother house.

releases.title: Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena
releases.synopsis: Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena builds upon Rice University's Center for the Impossible, one of the world's largest collections of paranormal research, by inviting everyday individuals, many of whom have never spoken publicly before, to reveal their new and personal encounters with unexplained phenomena.

releases.title: Emmerdale
releases.synopsis: Emmerdale is a British soap focusing on the lives of several families and locals living around an estate, a farm and the nearby village in the Yorkshire Dales. It is the second longest British soap in television history since airing its first episode on ITV in 1972, as 'Emmerdale Farm', the show was renamed in 1989.

releases.title: The Celebrity Traitors: Uncloaked
releases.synopsis: Ed Gamble is joined by the latest murdered and banished players to unpack all the drama from The Celebrity Traitors.

releases.title: It Gets Worse
releases.synopsis: It Gets Worse follows Ethan, Abi, and Sam - best friends from uni, soulmates for life, and dysfunctional roommates. It's been a year since they finally managed to move to London, they have collectively accomplished nothing, and now their landlord is selling up. They're getting kicked out. What now? Can they keep their friendships alive when they are dispersed across a city that seems to want them dead? Can they find a six out of ten or higher to have bad sex with? Can they get their shit together when the world is so obviously falling apart? Probably not. But they're going to have fun trying.It Gets Worse is a show about three young people who are starting to look around themselves - at their humiliating jobs, their non-existent love lives and their rapidly dwindling will to live - and think: wait. Wait wait WAIT. Surely it gets better than this? It has to get better than this. Right? Spoiler alert! It doesn't.

releases.title: Where the Mask Ends
releases.synopsis: An ambitious street urchin seizes the chance to impersonate a noblewoman and becomes a warlord's bride, but when her comatose husband awakens, she must navigate deadly schemes, win his heart through cunning, and uncover her royal heritage to triumph over rivals and rise from gutter to glory.

releases.title: NBC Nightly News
releases.synopsis: NBC Nightly News is the most-watched evening newscast in America, providing the very latest on the day's top stories and going beyond the headlines to add context and analysis to the most pressing issues of our time, both at home and abroad. We go to the heart of breaking news stories, introduce you to everyday people caught up in extraordinary events, offer in-depth reporting on health and medicine, cover international news as it unfolds and we profile those who inspire us to do better in our popular Making A Difference reports. The award-winning broadcast carries a legacy that spans more than six decades, beginning in 1948 - when NBC started broadcasting television's first-ever regularly scheduled network evening newscast.

releases.title: Killer Investigations
releases.synopsis: Detectives chase down leads, prosecutors go head-to-head with defense attorneys, and juries wrestle with life-or-death decisions.

releases.title: Countdown
releases.synopsis: The show in which two contestants engage in a battle of wits, competing against the clock in games of lexical dexterity and numerical agility.

releases.title: Kongen Befaler
releases.synopsis: Atle Antonsen takes on the role as the almighty king, with Olli Wermskog as his right hand assistant. In each program he gives absurd and practical assignments and challenges to five comedians, which they will have to solve in the most creative and effective way possible. Dirty tricks and bribes are allowed, and when all is said and done - and all dignity is gone - it's up to Atle Antonsen to decide who is this week's winner.

releases.title: Good Morning America
releases.synopsis: Good Morning America is a two-hour, live program anchored by Robin Roberts, George Stephanopoulos and Michael Strahan. Lara Spencer is the entertainmnt anchor, and Ginger Zee is the chief meteorologist.

releases.title: ABC World News Tonight with David Muir
releases.synopsis: With unparalleled resources, World News Tonight with David Muir provides the latest information and analysis of major events from around the country and the world.

releases.title: Trivial Pursuit
releases.synopsis: The all-time classic trivia game Trivial Pursuit is reimagined in a question-packed entertainment format. Gameplay takes place on a giant version of the iconic Trivial Pursuit game board, as contestants battle it out over a range of play-along question categories to win wedges and beat each other to the center. The victor then takes on a dramatic finale against the clock to claim the big money jackpot.

releases.title: The Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell
releases.synopsis: Drawing upon his experience as a former chief of staff on the Senate Finance Committee and as an Emmy-winning executive producer and writer of The West Wing, O'Donnell gives the last word and rewrites the most compelling stories of the day on The Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell.

releases.title: Aussie Shore
releases.synopsis: Aussie Shore follows the wild antics of a group of young and rowdy housemates as they work hard, and party even harder whilst navigating the highs and lows of living together 24/7 in the non-stop party town of Cairns.

releases.title: Today
releases.synopsis: Today is an American news and talk morning television show that airs on NBC. The program debuted on January 14, 1952. It was the first of its genre on American television and in the world, and is the fifth-longest-running American television series.

releases.title: All In with Chris Hayes
releases.synopsis: On All In with Chris Hayes, Chris Hayes delivers impactful stories that don't always make the front page. Drawing from his background as a reporter, Hayes goes on the road to uncover the truth by knocking on doors, digging deeper and speaking with people representing all points of view.

releases.title: Anderson Cooper 360°
releases.synopsis: Anderson Cooper 360° (commonly shortened to either AC-360 or 360) is a television news show on CNN, hosted by the American journalist Anderson Cooper. The program covers a number of news stories of the day, usually through live or taped reports from the network's correspondents. The coverage can also include analysis from experts on the issues, commonly featured in or after the taped reports.

releases.title: Let's Make a Deal
releases.synopsis: Let's Make a Deal is an updated version of the classic television game show, hosted by Emmy Award-winner Wayne Brady, where audience members try to win cash and prizes by making wacky deals.

releases.title: Scrabble
releases.synopsis: Scrabble is a captivating, fast-paced take on the global board-game phenomenon. In each episode, wordsmiths battle it out playing a series of addictive, word-based games to win points and add words to a giant SCRABBLE board in the center of the set.

releases.title: Inside the NBA
releases.synopsis: Inside the NBA is the postgame show for NBA on TNT broadcasts. The program features host Ernie Johnson with analysts Charles Barkley, Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. Occasionally, Johnson, Smith, Barkley, and O'Neal are joined by analysts Chris Webber and Grant Hill. The show has won nine Emmy Awards, Ernie has won three as a studio host and Charles Barkley has won two as a studio analyst.

releases.title: Strictly Come Dancing - It Takes Two
releases.synopsis: All the backstage gossip from Strictly Come Dancing, with the secrets, slips and stories from the practice rooms.

releases.title: Thursday Night Football on Prime Video
releases.synopsis: Thursday Night Football on Prime Video will provide members a unique viewing experience with interactive features that bring fans closer to the game, such as X-Ray and Next Gen Stats powered by AWS. Prime members will also be able to choose from multiple alternative audio options exclusive to Prime Video.

metadata.episode_name: New England Patriots at Chicago Bears

releases.title: CBS Evening News
releases.synopsis: The CBS Evening News, a daily evening broadcast featuring news reports, feature stories and interviews by CBS News correspondents and reporters covering events across world.

releases.title: Green Eyed Killers
releases.synopsis: True crime documentary revealing what happens when the green-eyed monster turns deadly.

releases.title: Swipe Right on the Devil
releases.synopsis: When 24-year-old Sydney Loofe disappears after a Tinder date, what begins as a missing-person case quickly spirals into a haunting mystery. As investigators race to uncover her whereabouts, they are drawn into an astounding world of manipulation, witchcraft, mind control and black magic. Each new lead uncovers disturbing revelations, exposing behavior that shocks even seasoned FBI agents. With every answer raising new questions, Sydney's story becomes a cautionary tale about trust, vulnerability and the hidden dangers that can lurk behind seemingly ordinary encounters, culminating in a chilling case that remains as perplexing as it is unforgettable.

releases.title: Home and Away
releases.synopsis: Home and Away is set in the fictional town of Summer Bay, a coastal town in New South Wales, and follows the personal and professional lives of the people living in the area. The show initially focused on the Fletcher family, Pippa and Tom Fletcher and their five foster children Frank Morgan, Carly Morris, Steven Matheson, Lynn Davenport and Sally Keating, who would go on to become one of the show's longest-running characters. The show also originally and currently focuses on the Stewart family. Home and Away had proved popular when it premiered in 1988 and had risen to become a hit in Australia, and after only a few weeks, the show tackled its first major and disturbing storyline, the rape of Carly Morris; it was one of the first shows to feature such storylines during the early timeslot. H&A has tackled many adult-themed and controversial storylines; something rarely found in its restricted timeslot.

releases.title: ABC World News Now
releases.synopsis: ABC World News Now gives viewers up-to-date information on current events and news from around the world, airing in the overnight hours. Its tone is somewhat lighter than a regular news broadcast, though reports are filed from the usual ABC News correspondents. Weather and pop culture stories round out the reports.

releases.title: Deadline: White House
releases.synopsis: Hosted by Nicolle Wallace, this program provides in-depth reporting and dynamic discussions on the political stories driving the news cycle. Nicolle Wallace brings viewers the latest political developments of the day, in addition to interviews with leading newsmakers and influential politicians. Drawing on her years of experience as communications chief for President George W. Bush and senior advisor for the McCain-Palin campaign, Wallace provides political insight and clarity on where key decision-makers stand on complex issues.

releases.title: The Five
releases.synopsis: The Five is an American news and talk show on Fox News Channel featuring a rotating panel who discuss current stories, political issues, and pop culture. The show premiered in July 2011, replacing the Glenn Beck program, and airs on weekdays at 5:00 p.m. ET with replays at 4:00 a.m. ET. On October 3, 2011, after successful ratings and high popularity, Fox News announced that The Five would become the permanent 5 p.m. series, as the program had previously been announced to last only during the summer. The Five is currently the second-most-watched program in all of cable news in the United States, placing only behind The O'Reilly Factor, also on the Fox News Channel. The program has occasionally been the number one rated cable news series in the key 25 to 54 viewing demographic.

releases.title: Loose Women
releases.synopsis: A weekday panel show presented by women for women. Watch our panellists discuss topical issues & showbiz while interviewing celebrity guests in front of a live studio audience.

releases.title: The Beat with Ari Melber
releases.synopsis: The Beat with Ari Melber delivers the biggest political and news stories of the day, with interviews and original reporting from around the nation. An Emmy-winning journalist, attorney and former Senate staffer, Melber cuts through the spin and the noise to tell you what's really happening. Real news, every night.

releases.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
releases.synopsis: A Bangers & Cash spin-off series that follows the journey of a vehicle purchased at a Mathewsons classic car auction, before being repaired, restored and then re-auctioned in order to try and find the vehicle a new home and loving owner. These genuine restoration projects, with varying degrees of difficulty, show how tricky it can really be to restore classic vehicles back to their former glory. Derek, Paul and Dave Mathewson are on hand to share their advice and observations on the variety of different jobs, which include an MG Montego Turbo with its engine in the boot, and a rare Lotus Elan S1 that hasn't seen a road for 47 years.

releases.title: Britain's Countryside Killers
releases.synopsis: This British series examines notorious murders that have had a lasting impact on rural communities in the UK. Each episode revisits a case that shocked once-peaceful towns and villages, highlighting how these seemingly idyllic settings were forever changed by violent crime. The series includes contributions from retired police detectives, forensic psychologists, and local journalists who provide detailed analysis of the investigative process behind each case.

releases.title: Did someone happen to mention me?
Studio C
releases.synopsis: One of BYUtv's most popular original series, the sketch-comedy show Studio C, brings you memorable characters like Scott Sterling, the Bisque Man, and the Awkward Avoidance Viking. Join the cast--including Whitney Call, Mallory Everton, Jason Gray, and Matt Meese--to enjoy more hilarious sketches and characters.

metadata.episode_name: Have I Shocked You? with Pete Holmes

releases.title: Tonight
releases.synopsis: A news-magazine programme presented by Julie Etchingham.

metadata.episode_name: Parking: Why Are We Paying So Much?

releases.title: Classic Movies: The Story of...
releases.synopsis: Classic Movies: The Story of... goes in search of the cinematically sublime. Those films that have transcended their era to enter the pantheon of greats.With each episode devoted to a single film, their story will be told with detail, affection, looking for the truth behind the myth, all the trials and triumphs that went into forging a classic. But this isn't simply history, the standard making of, it's about identifying those ingredients immortal scenes, performances, themes, luxuriant cinematography, art direction, special effects, music, even the power of a single line – that elevate a film to a new level.Hosted by Ian Nathan, guide us through the story from inception to legacy, supplemented with regular input along with special guest, with unique insight, historians who have devoted entire books, and visit to special location, where they shot or that served as  a key inspiration, bringing each of these films to life with a dynamic presentation. We are on a journey to find out not what makes a film good, but what makes it classic.

releases.title: 71° nord - Norges tøffeste kjendis
releases.synopsis: Ten celebrities get to experience Norway at its most beautiful and get to test their physical limits, competing for the title «Norway's toughest celebrity».

metadata.episode_name: Nok en dag i total lidelse

releases.title: The Tamron Hall Show
releases.synopsis: Former news host and journalist Tamron Hall discusses all things topical and engages those she interviews in thorough meaningful and entertaining conversations.

releases.title: Morning Joe
releases.synopsis: On Morning Joe, the hosts Joe Scarborough, Mika Brzezinski, and Willie Geist engage in dynamic discussion about political news and issues important to all Americans. Morning Joe attracts a variety of guests, including top newsmakers, politicians and cultural influencers.

releases.title: Special Report
releases.synopsis: Special Report with Bret Baier (formerly Special Report with Brit Hume) is an American television news and political commentary program appearing on Fox News Channel, currently hosted by Bret Baier. It airs live each Monday through Friday at 6:00 PM ET. The show focuses on both reporting and analysis of the day's events, with a primary focus on national political news. The show has been a part of the Fox News program lineup since 1998 and is the number one cable news broadcast in its time slot.

releases.title: The Ingraham Angle
releases.synopsis: The Ingraham Angle cuts through the Washington chatter to speak directly with unexpected voices and the actual people who are impacted by the news of the day.

releases.title: Hannity
releases.synopsis: Sean Hannity interviews political figures and newsmakers and offers his own perspective.

releases.title: Make Me Tremble
releases.synopsis: Depicts the story of Yeon Su, a woman raised in a conservative household who works at a marketing company and has lived her life while maintaining her chastity, as she meets a man who is the CEO of an adult product company. As their worlds collide, they challenge each other's beliefs and grow together in unexpected ways.

releases.title: Critical Role
releases.synopsis: Critical Role is a weekly actual play series that uses tabletop role-playing game mechanics as a means to explore and develop stories from the vast fantasy worlds of Exandria, Aramán, and beyond, with sweeping narratives intricately woven through collaboration between Game Masters and players.

releases.title: Help! We Bought a Village
releases.synopsis: British people rebuilding abandoned historic settlements in Europe.

releases.title: Die Bergretter
releases.synopsis: Die Bergretter is a German mountain rescue television series. The series is set in the Austrian Alps and centers around a fictional mountain rescue team in Ramsau am Dachstein. Each episode focuses on a rescue mission, explores the background stories of the people involved the incident (more often than not caused by their risky behaviour) and the private lives of the team members.

releases.title: Alle mot alle
releases.synopsis: Who are the smartest celebrities that Norway has to offer? Norwegian celebs meet for a very hard and entertaining educational battle, led by Henriette Steenstrup and Jon Almaas.

releases.title: NFL Live
releases.synopsis: NFL Live is a National Football League studio show, currently airing Monday through Friday at 7:00 p.m ET on ESPN2. Formerly known as NFL 2Night, the program is one of the only NFL-related studio programs to air during the week along with NFL Insiders. As such, NFL Live is not a highlight show, as Sunday and Monday game highlights are handled by the various other NFL studio shows, including NFL Primetime during the season. Unlike shows for other sports, NFL Live even runs throughout the entire off season.

releases.title: Gutfeld!
releases.synopsis: Late night show with author, comedian and television host and producer Greg Gutfeld, offering up satirical political and social commentary with a weekly panel of guests.

releases.title: Zhu Xian
releases.synopsis: A terrible calamity has fallen onto Zhang Fan, not only becoming one of the three survivors of Grass Temple Village, where everyone else was horribly massacred, he was also tasked to carry one of the most evil artifacts, the Sinister Bead, and taught one of the most secret teachings of the Skysong Sect, the Brahmin Wisdom. Now he cultivates in the Jadeon Sect, his knowledge and possession will draw him into a chaotic story where he will have to carry some of the greatest burdens of the Martial World.

releases.title: FOX & Friends
releases.synopsis: FOX & Friends is a conservative American early-morning news and opinion talk show on the Fox News Channel. It begins at 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time with the latest Fox News Live headlines and news of the morning and continues with a variety of segments including current events, interviews, updates of news stories with correspondents, right-leaning analysis from the hosts, and entertainment segments.

releases.title: America's Newsroom
releases.synopsis: Watch 'America's Newsroom' on Fox News Channel - follow Bill Hemmer and Dana Perino Weekdays 9 a.m. - 11 a.m. ET as they bring you the news that matters to you.

releases.title: First Take
releases.synopsis: First Take (aka: ESPN First Take) is a weekday sports talk show co-hosted by Stephen A. Smith, Max Kellerman and Molly Qerim who are joined by regular contributors and special guests. The show includes daily sports news, interviews with sports journalists, athletes and personalities, spirited debates, and an assortment of other topics. The show debuted 7 May 2007 as "Cold Pizza".

releases.title: Max & the Midknights
releases.synopsis: Max & the Midknights follows a determined 10-year-old girl named Max, who pursues her dream of becoming a knight by leading her friends on an epic adventure in the fantastical medieval kingdom of Byjovia.

releases.title: Against the Gods
releases.synopsis: Mythical Abode Mountain, Cloud's End Cliff, the most dangerous of Azure Cloud Continent's four deadly areas. Cloud's End Cliff's base is known as the Grim Reaper's Cemetery. Over countless years, the number of people that have fallen off this cliff is too high to count. None of them, even three stronger than god masters, whose power could pierce the heavens, have been able to return alive. However, a boy that's being chased by various people because he alone holds a priceless treasure jumps off the cliff, but instead of dying he wakes up in the body of a boy with the same name in another world. This is the story of a boy wielding the Sky Poison Pearl, cultivating the strength to oppose heaven and earth, a lord overlooking the world. —Novel Updates

releases.title: Fool in Love
releases.synopsis: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

releases.title: Farmen
releases.synopsis: Farmen is a reality TV seriescreated by Swedish producer Strix. Sold to more than 40 countries, The Farm is one of their most popular formats including Survivor, The Bar, or Fame Factory. Like in Big Brother-shows, The Farm puts a group of 12 people living together in a farm. There, the contestants must work as a normal farmer, raising animals and doing agriculture. In regular periods of time, one of the houseguests is evicted, usually in a ceremony called The Duel where they compete in a physical endurance, but in some adaptations of the show its the audience who decide who must leave The Farm.

releases.title: The Story

releases.title: André Hazes: En Nu...
releases.synopsis: In the reality series, we see a new phase begin following the final concert of his successful theater tour. He dives right in with his signature positive energy and humor—he isn't one to sit still, and that is exactly what we will see.

releases.title: Striguni
releases.synopsis: Origolab, an internationally renowned genetical engineering company, establishes a new headquarters within the walls of a small medieval town in Istria and Boris, an ambitous up and coming biologist, gets a position in it. However, he discovers a terrifying secret: whilst Origolab might be on the verge of a scientific breakthrough with discovering eternal life, they have been kidnapping local children to achieve this, putting him before a moral dilemma. Should he try to save the most recent kidnapping victim? Or will he bend under the promise of the scientific discovery of a century?

releases.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
releases.synopsis: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

releases.title: Pranker
releases.synopsis: Anton is a professional prankster. He believes that he is doing justice by tricking and then leaking secret information about corrupt officials and big shots. But one day, Anton himself finds himself drawn into a conflict between business competitors, in which the life of the prankster's sister is at stake.

releases.title: THE MEASURED EVERLASTING IS 1.334 BILLION YEARS
releases.synopsis: In Thai Buddhist cosmology, a kalpa is an immeasurable span of time — here imagined as 1.334 billion years, long enough for bodies, memories, and worlds to dissolve.  Beginning in hell and expanding toward the edge of the universe, The Measured Everlasting is 1.334 Billion Years moves through Buddhist scripture, Thai gay pornographic print culture, forensic footage, personal memory, AI simulations, and political fable. At its center is the filmmaker’s fear of death: not simply as an ending, but as the collapse of identity, desire, and memory before everything returns to chaos.

releases.title: The Perfect Holiday
releases.synopsis: The group of friends from “Das perfekte Geheimnis” have to ask themselves the question on a chaotic short trip to the south: Is there life after the truth or is their friendship over?

releases.title: La Venganza del Charro Negro
releases.synopsis: The return of Leo San Juan and all the legends.

releases.title: Nakee 3: The Cursed War
releases.synopsis: As destiny turns lovers into enemies, duty tears them apart, but love remembers what kingdoms forget, the love can end even the oldest war.

releases.title: È un mondo difficile
releases.synopsis: Elena and Francesco are bound by a love full of ups and downs, a visceral bond that spans the years, the distances, and diverging life choices. As their paths seem to drift apart, something keeps pulling them back to each other. He finds a new balance with Marta, while she becomes involved with Arthur, who offers her stability and a marriage proposal. But with her wedding just around the corner, the only choice left is the one they’ve never had the courage to make.

releases.title: Overman
releases.synopsis: Overman, a fading superhero, takes a job with the government's Department of Public Security in an attempt to get back on his feet. While working alongside Pâmela, his loyal partner who is beginning to gain as much recognition as he has, Overman confronts his toxic masculinity and uncovers dark secrets involving the governor. Now, he must face his inner demons and an old enemy to prevent the city from plunging into irreversible chaos.

releases.title: The 4 Lives of Pyotr Mamonov
releases.synopsis: How did four contradictory personas coexist within a single individual—rowdy drifter, rock star, great actor, and Orthodox hermit? Pavel Lungin’s new film chronicles the life journey of Pyotr Mamonov, exploring his search for meaning and the spiritual transformation of this cult musician and actor. The film weaves together unique archival footage, interviews spanning years, previously unseen home videos, and recollections from those close to him—including Sergey Shnurov, Evgeny Margulis, Viktor Sukhorukov, his wife Olga Mamonova, Viktoriya Isakova, Sergey Loban, and many others.

releases.title: Uniform: Cinta di Balik Seragam
releases.synopsis: Young officer Jason must face a bitter reality. Lara, his girlfriend, has been murdered in a staged accident. Noticing numerous inconsistencies, he asks the Commander to join the investigation. A series of events reveals facts linking a criminal syndicate to the tragedy that befell his girlfriend.

releases.title: The Night Everything Changed
releases.synopsis: When Tina's teenage daughter doesn't return home from a sleepover with her closest friends, she goes on a frantic hunt to find her before it's too late. In the process, she unravels dark secrets of a forbidden romance and a tryst among BFFs.

releases.title: A Christmas Prayer Tradition
releases.synopsis: Natalie prepares for the launch of her debut children’s book, Adeline the Angel, while Wes continues to deepen his faith journey. When Caroline quietly begins a mission to answer the prayers and needs of those around her community, the family discovers that some of God’s greatest works are accomplished through simple acts of kindness. As Christmas approaches, Bellford Falls once again becomes a place where hope is restored, prayers are answered, and hearts are drawn closer to the reason for the season.

releases.title: Fallen Angels
releases.synopsis: Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.

releases.title: The Heritage
releases.synopsis: Árpi (known to his sons simply as “Boss”) has been living alone for years after losing his wife, with whom he spent more than fifty years. In recent months, Árpi has spent practically all of his savings. His two sons, Attila and Kristóf, only realize this when the old man’s electricity is cut off due to his accumulated debt. This is more than strange for the elderly man, who lives a modest life, but he refuses to say a word about where the one and a half million forints went. Attila and Kristóf work together to coax the truth out of him: he gave the money to Hajnalka, a young woman with a difficult past. But who is this Hajnalka, whom they’ve never heard of before? The old man claims he’s in love. The boys claim the old man is being taken advantage of. Everyone clings to their own version of the truth. But the truth must be uncovered. The longest night of their lives begins. And even Hajnalka appears at the front door.

releases.title: The Lord of Cold
releases.synopsis: Sisters Maria and Anastasia are best friends, and they cope not only with a grumpy mother, but also with ancient magic, because of which winter has not come in their village for many decades. The girls manage to overcome all obstacles, drive away the evil witch, melt the heart of the Lord of Cold, and also find love.

releases.title: Die andere Seite
releases.synopsis: Since losing her family, a woman is living alone in the wilderness — far away from society, which is dominated by mistrust and fear after the outbreak of a fatal disease. When she is forced to leave this life behind, she not only experiences a boundless freedom, but also remembers the importance of human closeness and the feeling of belonging.

releases.title: The Absurd Story of Gialappa’s Band
releases.synopsis: Forty years after their beginnings on the frequencies of Radio Popolare, Gialappa’s Band retraces its professional history in a film directed by Walter Veltroni.With his attentive and original perspective, the director takes us through four decades of comedy, invention, and irony, recounting the journey of Giorgio Gherarducci, Marco Santin, and Carlo Taranto, three leading figures who revolutionized the language of entertainment in Italy. L’assurda storia della Gialappa’s Band explores the creative universe of the legendary trio and the mark left by their unique brand of comedy, capable of transcending generations and becoming an integral part of Italian popular culture.

releases.title: No Paradise If You Are Killed by a Woman
releases.synopsis: A female Kurdish-Norwegian sniper returns to the battlefield she once escaped, driven by vengeance and by the desperate hope of rescuing her younger sister, still imprisoned by ISIS in Mosul.

releases.title: Miss Representation: Rise Up
releases.synopsis: MISS REPRESENTATION: RISING dives deep into the cultural backlash against women’s mental health, agency, and political power with technology exacerbating sexism and misogyny towards women and girls.

releases.title: GunBlade & Me
releases.synopsis: An obsessed, washed-up Sydney filmmaker sets out to uncover what led to the cancellation of his viral high school web series, GunBlade Adventures.

releases.title: Gazelle
releases.synopsis: Yakup, a Turkish music teacher seeking political asylum in New York, is trying to keep his head above water as he navigates the US immigration system. Working illegally in a restaurant kitchen with a lively group of fellow immigrants, he is laser focused on laying the groundwork to bring his wife and daughter abroad. In a desperate attempt to expedite the process, he seeks help from a group of shady fellow countrymen who resort to risky methods to get people out of Turkey. But things quickly go sideways and chances to reunite with his loved ones deteriorate by the minute.

releases.title: Свинцовые небеса
releases.synopsis: The plot tells of several civilians captured by the Ukrainian side and locked in an Orthodox church. The Ukrainian Armed Forces plan to use this point as a trap to close the cauldron for the Russian army, and to use the civilians as a human shield. Having learned about this, the heroes develop their own plan, ready to die, but not to allow the implementation of the plans of the Ukrainian nationalists.

releases.title: A Whimsy Christmas Carol
releases.synopsis: When the ambitious of a beloved toy company faces a looming corporate takeover, she must rediscover the true meaning of the holiday with the help of the Christmas Spirits  and a charming former flame who has always believed in her  or risk losing everything she’s worked so hard to build.

releases.title: Whiskey Throttle
releases.synopsis: When a lone outsider infiltrates a cartel-run motocross empire and walks away with its kingpin's fortune, he becomes the target of a deadly pursuit stretching 100 miles across the desert to the border.

releases.title: Will You Be My Son?
releases.synopsis: Lucía, a 42-year-old woman, discovers her partner's infidelity after a 15-year relationship and must reorganize her personal and professional life. She asks her young neighbor to pretend to be her son for a job opportunity.

releases.title: Fake It Till You Break Shit
releases.synopsis: Jeanie, who is homeless, works from her car in a dubious network marketing job. When she is invited to her old school friends' bachelorette party, she senses an opportunity to sell them her products. But she has underestimated how much she wants to finally be part of the group again.

releases.title: Kabaddi 5: After the Final Match
releases.synopsis: As Kaji steps into a new chapter of his life, familiar faces return while new characters enter his world, each bringing their own motives, desires, and complications. With new dreams and new responsibilities, Kaji finds himself facing challenges he never expected.

releases.title: The Night Arezou Disappeared
releases.synopsis: During the 2022 protests in Tehran, piano teacher Rana’s teenage sister, Arezou, disappears. With her ex-partner and close friends, Rana searches for her through a long and desperate night, an experience shared by many Iranian families during the Women, Life, Freedom uprising. As the night goes on, they begin to see Arezou in strange, fleeting moments, making it harder to separate what is real from what they fear or remember. When Rana’s conservative sister arrives, tensions inside the family grow, caused by the very different ways the two women have learned to live in Iran.

releases.title: Changes
releases.synopsis: Changes is an original comedy about people in contemporary Prague who, at various stages of their lives, are trying to work out who they are, what they actually want, and whether they have fulfilled their dreams. With humour, grit and a sense of perspective, the film reflects on intergenerational relationships, identity crises and the pressures of a consumerist age, whilst delivering a series of unexpected twists. Prague is a city of seven bridges that connect both riverbanks and people’s destinies. A vibrant place where you are surrounded by people, and yet where one can feel painfully alone.

releases.title: Detention
releases.synopsis: When four high schoolers get “Saturday Detention”, they quickly realize things just got a whole lot worse when they discover what they thought was just a waste-of-time detention turns into a bit of a nightmare… Group Therapy!

releases.title: MACE – An Out of Body Experience
releases.synopsis: For the second time in his career, MACE returns to Milan’s Forum, bringing together on stage the artists who have given voice to his musical universe: Venerus, Gemitaiz, Joan Thiele, Salmo, and many others.More than a chronicle of a concert, the film is a journey through perception: from intimacy to collective experience, from control to ecstasy. Through the words of the artists and images of the preparations and the show, it follows the creation of a shared experience. Rehearsals, stage, and audience merge into a flow in which the boundary between reality and hallucination becomes increasingly blurred.

releases.title: Gupi and the King Who Doesn't Smile
releases.synopsis: Gupi and her friends enter an abandoned apartment in their building to deliver a cake. By passing through a closet in one of the rooms, they find themselves in a dark, unhappy, and otherworldly dimension. This place is home to the palace of the King Who Does Not Smile, whose sorrow has spread across the entire realm. Realizing that the inhabitants of this dimension have lost their joy because the King never smiles, Gupi begins trying various methods to restore happiness to the kingdom.

releases.title: Charbel: The Movie
releases.synopsis: When Youssef Makhlouf was born in 1828, the small northern Lebanese village of BeqaaKafra had no idea it was welcoming a future saint. Saint Charbel would go on to bless and heal people of all religions, all around the world. This is simply the biopic of Charbel, the Saint of all Saints!

releases.title: Titans
releases.synopsis: Small-time gangster Antony Yakuza teams up with young programmer Anwar to pull off a major heist, with mysterious driver Rejimon joining them. But Rejimon is not who he seems, and their simple crime soon turns into a strange, unpredictable journey where reality itself begins to blur.

releases.title: Titans
releases.synopsis: Small-time gangster Antony Yakuza teams up with young programmer Anwar to pull off a major heist, with mysterious driver Rejimon joining them. But Rejimon is not who he seems, and their simple crime soon turns into a strange, unpredictable journey where reality itself begins to blur.

releases.title: Women as Lovers
releases.synopsis: Although hostess Brigitte and life-loving schoolgirl Paula only meet in person once, their fates and lives are closely intertwined.

releases.title: Amarte
releases.synopsis: He lives in his own universe. She is a famous soap opera star who needs to disappear from hers. When they meet by accident, what seems like a bad idea becomes a getaway as absurd as it is irresistible. As they flee from the press, between increasingly out of place situations, delirious moments and a connection that no one saw coming, both discover that escaping from reality can be much more fun... and dangerously irresistible for the heart. But when the real world reaches them again, they will have to decide if that encounter was just a perfect fantasy or if it is worth the risk of experiencing something real.

releases.title: Transferatu
releases.synopsis: Viktor and his young female companion Luna have been living in Berlin for over 100 years. They are junkies, kept going by drugs, blood, and art. They have no fixed sexual orientation, living without sexual intercourse. Young male drug dealers are their primary victims, who end up dying as they orgasm. Klaus is their manager and chauffeur, constantly at their beck and call. He utilizes the dead bodies, selling them for transplant purposes. He loves old American films about exploitation, personally embodying their characters. When Vlad, Viktor’s father, disinherits his son due to his drug addiction, their excesses escalate. Viktor becomes captivated by Mandy, a trans woman. Luna joins them, and in a sensual frenzy, they merge with Mandy until dawn breaks.

releases.title: El Club de la Seducción
releases.synopsis: The film follows two men with opposing personalities whose lives unexpectedly cross paths. Driven by a debt, parties, romances, and impulsive decisions, they find themselves caught up in a series of chaotic situations that blend humor, action, and romance.

releases.title: A Tale of Lost Times
releases.synopsis: An ordinary school day turns into a fantastic adventure for Petya, Marusya, and Vasya when their idle time becomes the source of power for three old wizards. In pursuit of youth, the villains steal the students' time with a magical gadget, but in their haste, they themselves turn into children, and the children into helpless old men. To set things right, they must not only win the magical battle but also lift the spell before sunset, and most importantly, understand the value of every wasted minute.

releases.title: The Girl with the Leica
releases.synopsis: On Bastille Day in 1937, pioneering German-Jewish photojournalist Gerda Taro spends her final day in Paris confronting her past, her complex partnership with Robert Capa, and her absolute commitment to anti-fascist resistance before returning to the front lines of the Spanish Civil War.

releases.title: Lingsir Wengi: Motel Malioboro
releases.synopsis: To grow the DuniaHorror62 YouTube channel, Putik—who has the ability to see and communicate with spirits—joins forces with Ryan, Anggie, Aro, Dita, and their friends to visit an old motel in Malioboro. A forbidden room in the motel becomes their target for content, in hopes of making their channel go viral. Despite being warned, this group of young people recklessly enters the room anyway. Inside, they discover a tape recorder containing a recording of the song “Lingsir Wengi.” As soon as the song plays, eerie events and terror begin to haunt them. Putik realizes they’ve awakened a spirit—one that doesn’t just want to communicate, but has come bearing wrath and demanding vengeance be settled. This spirit reveals dark secrets and conflicts within their friendship. They must find a way to stop it before they lose their lives.

releases.title: Ekeko: El Muñeco de la Suerte
releases.synopsis: The story follows Gabriela, a young woman seeking to heal the deep wounds of a traumatic past. In her desperation, she decides to invoke a traditional Ekeko doll to heal and change her destiny. However, what initially seems to bring her good fortune soon transforms into her worst nightmare. The plot explores how the unbridled pursuit of prosperity distorts the amulet's essence when it interacts with Taitaorco, a powerful mountain spirit. Under the stark premise that "greed is a deadly sin" and "every stroke of luck comes at a price," a sinister ancestral rule is revealed: if the cigarette offered to the statuette goes out before burning completely, a portal to the underworld (Uku Pacha) opens, awakening malevolent entities ready to violently collect on favors rendered in exchange for your very soul.

releases.title: Siti Vampire
releases.synopsis: Siti is an ordinary girl who accidentally turned into a vampire due to a strange incident. She is trapped at the age of 25 forever, along with all her problems. Siti must find a way to cure herself and return to being a normal human being.

releases.title: Of astronauts and ghosts
releases.synopsis: Pedro, the grandfather, Maria, the granddaughter, José, who works as a consignee, and a migrant mother in Spain: these four characters tell us a story that unfolds in the intimate universe of a single place, a labyrinth of relationships and revelations that becomes a surprising metaphor for the country's past and present within a family: a terminally ill grandfather, a youthful love story, the old man who refuses to die, the new man who struggles to come into the world... only one solution is possible...

releases.title: Behind the Lines
releases.synopsis: Documentary based on three New York Times bestselling books by historian Andrew Carroll and inspired by the stage play If All the Sky Were Paper, the film tells the story of Carroll, who travels the world to seek out the greatest war letters ever written

releases.title: To the Victory!
releases.synopsis: A dystopian story set in post-war Ukraine, where a frustrated film director struggles to make the most of his life after being denied the opportunity to pursue his movie-making career. Estranged from his wife and daughter, who have been living in Vienna and are reluctant to return to their war-torn nation, the director tries to find solace in his conviction that the difficult times will pass and life will return to normal.

releases.title: On a Bright Blessed Day
releases.synopsis: Gita, an island woman traumatized by the sea, urges her fiancé Dama—a fisherman—to become a tour guide. Caught between the land and the sea, the two must choose one.

releases.title: Materia Prima
releases.synopsis: Bolivia has the world's largest deposits of lithium, a metal that is essential for the energy transition. Without lithium, no electricity storage facility, no data centre, no electric car, no smartphone would work. The Europeans want the raw material to save their automotive industry. The Bolivians want it to combat poverty. While the Bolivian government negotiates with corporations from around the world, civil society groups are mobilising in rural areas, organised mainly by women. The film offers a rare insight into the Europeans' strategy to secure the sought-after material and carves out the conflicting interests towards extractivism and industrialisation in Bolivia.

releases.title: The Space We Call Home
releases.synopsis: In the not-too-distant future, humans want to set foot on Mars, even colonize the hostile planet. The studies on this endeavor offer surprising perspectives on the ecological crisis on Earth. Discussing space travel, architecture, ecology, and the cities of tomorrow, this documentary essay unfolds a philosophical mosaic about our living spaces. What begins as a technological utopia leads to the central questions of our time. How do we want to live, work, and do business in the future?

releases.title: Giants Do Fall
releases.synopsis: It’s a classic David vs. Goliath scenario: in the oil and gas strongholds of Louisiana's River Parishes and Appalachia's Rust Belt, where false economic promises and industrial pollution have become the norm, fed-up residents square off against their politicians and big business, proving to be a formidable foe. Thrust into the role of accidental activists, the group exposes how racism, classism, and corruption fuel the systems around them, and channel their collective power to show that ordinary people can fight back – and that giants do fall.

releases.title: Led by the Ashes
releases.synopsis: Two sisters, Bethânia and Laura, reunite to discuss a family matter. They travel the roads of the Pernambuco hinterland in search of their father's body, Seu Lauro. At home, Bethânia's daughter edits a video in which the living and the dead become intertwined in a game of silences and revelations. Ao Sabor das Cinzas (Led by the Ashes) is a magical realism piece about the collapse of communication and grief conveyed in real time.

releases.title: Beautiful Pain
releases.synopsis: Amidst a contentious divorce, a single mother secures an unexpected breakthrough in the film industry to establish financial independence, only to face institutional workplace hazards and a predatory custody battle orchestrated by her former spouse.

releases.title: Girl Beast
releases.synopsis: Girl Beast is a psychological drama with a magical  and heightened reality, that tells a Lolita story from Lolita's point of view. Sara is a girl beast, an object of desire and a being of desire.  The story is adapted from Cecilie Lind’s novel with the same title. It balances between self-assertion and self-destruction. Loss and liberation. Powerlessness and power.

releases.title: The Lost Mariachis
releases.synopsis: Blending road movie, archival footage, and essayistic elements, this documentary chronicles a filmmaker's journey through the Balkans in search of the last Yu-Mex singers. Through a lost film by Emilio "El Indio" Fernández, this bittersweet story takes a playful approach in exploring how cinema and music migrate and are reinterpreted in distant contexts.

releases.title: Neda
releases.synopsis: An Iranian interpreter at the Federal Office for Migration and Refugees encounters her former torturer, now seeking asylum himself. Caught between her professional duty and the pursuit of justice, she needs to decide how far she is willing to go.

releases.title: Where Is My Head 2
releases.synopsis: khmer movie

releases.title: Wonder Beast
releases.synopsis: With fairy-tale inhabitants, everything is the same as with people - when a marriage breaks up, Resentment remains... That is the name of the daughter of the powerful magicians Bolotnitsa and Chernogor, who divorced but continue to share power over the child. On the day of Resentment's coming of age, it turns out that she is deprived of the magical power that was supposed to be inherited from her parents. To fix the situation, Resentment urgently needs to find a groom in the human world, have a wedding and sacrifice the person - turn him into a tree... Together with Resentment, her mysterious friend, Chudo Yudo, goes to the human world. He can transform into anyone: a bird, an animal, and even a handsome prince.

releases.title: Pirunduk
releases.synopsis: A wronged wife in a remote village on the Tanah Banjar river, South Kalimantan. When she becomes a wandering spirit, she seeks revenge on those who have hurt her and collects debts that have not been paid off during her lifetime.

releases.title: Art, Chaos, Riot
releases.synopsis: The documentary follows María Riot, an artist, activist, and sex worker from Argentina, as she develops her photography project “Archivo Puta” through conversations, encounters, and photo shoots. It offers a personal glimpse into María’s life, her creative process, and her journey into photography. At the same time, the film explores the portrayal of sex work and questions the boundaries between objectification, self-determination, and political expression.

releases.title: Case File 427-26
releases.synopsis: A sister brings her brother to see the unfinished house she's moving into. Still under construction and eerily quiet, the property harbors an unsettling presence that neither can explain.

releases.title: SNOW
releases.synopsis: A couple's future is put into question.

releases.title: Dear Debbie
releases.synopsis:
Sometimes, enough is enough…

Debbie Mullen is losing it. For years, she has compiled all of her best advice into her column, Dear Debbie, where the wives of New England come for sympathy and neighborly advice. Through her work, Debbie has heard from countless women who are ignored, belittled, or even abused by their husbands. And Debbie does her best to guide them in the right direction. Or at least, she did.

These days, Debbie’s life seems to be spiraling out of control. She just lost her job. Something strange is happening with her teenage daughters. And her husband is keeping secrets, according to the tracking app she installed on his phone. Now, Debbie’s done being the bigger person.

She’s done being reasonable and practical. It’s time to take her own advice.

And now it’s time for payback against all the people in her life who deserve it the most.

releases.title: Persona
releases.synopsis:
**A trans woman discovers pornography of herself she has no memory of making, only to find herself led to an unimaginably deeper evil.**

A feral shut-in discovers a disturbing internet porn video of what seems to be herself. A seance of coked-up artists summons unearthly forces in a studio apartment. The staircase of an exurban marketing company descends endlessly beneath the earth. 

In Aoife Josie Clements’ electric, nightmarish, intricately layered novel, the impossibility of goodness crowds in upon two young trans women barely surviving on sex work and zero-hours contracts. Below the familiar evils of capitalism and the bottomless depths of internet culture, a darker horror awaits. What curse follows these women? What are they escaping? What are they running towards?

releases.title: KYOTO lo sguardo del drago
releases.synopsis: Un fantasy thriller, come in un film, dal lusso degli yacht di Portofino ai ruderi di un antico castello in Giappone. Il prezioso pugnale del samurai demone Nobunaga è scomparso. Michele, geniale decifratore di codici segreti, Alexander, affascinante milionario irlandese, Gretel, eclettica signora, e Yoshida, investigatore privato, sono i fantastici quattro che indagano per svelare il mistero in un crescendo da vivere minuto dopo minuto: gli azzardi, i ninja, l'onore e l'amicizia, l'amore e la morte. Tragica e fiabesca, cinica e poetica, una storia dura ammantata di dolcezza ed elegante ironia fino alla spietata soluzione.

releases.title: The Man Who Vanished
releases.synopsis:
**What would you become  if no one could see you?**

A gripping psychological thriller of invisibility, obsession, and power. Deep within Egypt, a discovery changes everything. When I encounter something never meant to be found, my world fractures. I vanish from sight—but not from consequence. Liberation mutates into obsession, freedom into a mind slipping beyond control.

Unseen, I move through the world’s shadows—navigating criminal networks, exposing hidden conspiracies, unearthing truths buried for centuries. Invisibility becomes more than an ability: it becomes temptation, weapon, and curse.

Each step deeper into the unseen erodes the boundaries between justice and transgression, control and compulsion. But the greatest danger is not the enemies I pursue. It is the darkness awakening within me. As curiosity hardens into obsession, morality fractures.

Some hungers leave scars you cannot see. And when power begins to consume rather than empower, survival becomes a battle not only against those who hunt me—but against the consequences of everything I have done. 

The Man Who Vanished is a gripping psychological thriller fused with political intrigue, conspiracies and espionage suspense. Relentless tension meets psychological depth in a story about invisibility, obsession, and the devastating cost of crossing unseen lines.

Perfect for readers who love:

✔ Psychological thrillers
✔ Political and conspiracy thrillers
✔ Espionage and spy fiction
✔ Dark suspense and moral dilemmas
✔ High-stakes international intrigue

Fans of high-tension, mind-bending thrillers and stories of identity, secrecy, and psychological descent will be captivated by its atmosphere, intensity, and escalating suspense. 
Are you ready to vanish into the unseen?

Notice: Contains mature themes and strong scenes intended for mature readers.

releases.title: Titanium, The Life & Memoirs Of Toby Ti Mustard
releases.synopsis: Titanium: Life of X is a raw, visionary memoir by ordained minister and creative leader Toby Ti Mustard. This spiritual autobiography traces a journey of awakening, reincarnation, and resilience — a life forged in silence, shaped by struggle, and elevated by purpose. Set against the backdrop of Ross County, Ohio, Toby’s story unfolds through mystical insight, personal transformation, and a calling to serve. Titanium is not just a book — it’s a declaration of identity, a spiritual blueprint, and a testament to the unbreakable force of becoming.

releases.title: The Beeston Genesis
releases.synopsis: A historical and analytical study examining the role of Robert William Felkin in the formation and codification of modern Western Tarot systems. The paper situates Felkin’s work within the intellectual and social context of Beeston, Nottinghamshire, and traces how these early influences informed later Golden Dawn Tarot structures.

releases.title: My Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Dad
releases.synopsis: This work serves as the primary case study for Sir Jacob Kristopher Anders' research into Digital Provenance and Media Ethics (Ref: Wikidata Q138334536).

releases.title: A Good Person
releases.synopsis:
Lillian and Henry have been enjoying each other’s company, especially in bed. Even though Lillian’s best friend calls it “situationship,” Lillian is determined to lock Henry down—and she has a plan. She’ll be the best, most accommodating version of herself until he falls in love with her. But when Henry blindsides Lillian with a breakup, Lillian exacts revenge by performing a drunken hex on him.

Lillian expects Henry to come crawling back to her. What she doesn’t quite anticipate is becoming a prime suspect in his murder case when he’s found dead. As Lillian grapples with the loss of her sort-of-boyfriend, she’s hit with another reckoning: That Henry had a long-term girlfriend he also left behind.

releases.title: Love and Other Curses

For the Kingdom. For the magic. And for love . . .

But they are also on a secret to discover the Lost Quarter of the college, create their own coven of twelve and try to discover a way to bring back the Old Magic. 

When malevolent magic interrupts their first night at college, Aurelia and Jules discover that Jonathan and his coven of untethered witches has escaped and now they are after her magic, curse and all…

releases.title: The Writers Retreat

**A wickedly twisty and atmospheric thriller set at a writers' retreat in the South of France, The Writers Retreat is Knives Out meets Anna Downes’ The Safe Place from an exciting new voice in the thriller/mystery space.**

Welcome to The Writers Retreat – a creative haven for writers to hone their plotlines and sharpen their characters while soaking up the Provençal atmosphere. But this year’s retreat offers something different, as real-life blurs with fiction, and suspense isn't contained to the page.

Kat Hale is a bestselling Australian author crumbling under the pressure of writing her second novel. On a whim, she has fled to a writers retreat in the South of France run by internationally acclaimed author Helen Thorne. What Kat hopes will be two blissfully uninterrupted weeks to focus on her writing in anonymity quickly turns into something more sinister, when Kat begins to suspect that Helen isn't quite as perfect as everyone seems to believe.

Will Kat’s drive to uncover the truth about Helen be any match for Helen’s desire to hold onto her career, her reputation and her writing retreat, or is Kat at risk of falling victim to a more dangerous climax?

releases.title: The Radiant Dark

***Arrival meets Wild Dark Shore in this captivating novel that follows a family for over fifty years—a bold and compassionate exploration of the universe around us and what it truly means to be human.***

They have just had their first child, and though Carol is struggling with the challenges of new motherhood, her future seems clear. Until something extraordinary happens: an inexplicable flickering of light in the sky, which is ultimately determined to be communication from intelligent life on another planet. But these beings are eleven light-years away, and nothing is known about them other than the fact that they seem to know we exist too. And so begins a decades-long exchange of messages with this mysterious, faraway civilization.

As humanity reels from a shifting understanding of its place in the universe, we follow the stories of the Girard family: Carol, whose fascination with this other life sparks a desperate search for spiritual meaning; Michael, her loyal son, who finds solace not in the stars above his head but in the ground beneath his feet; and Ro, Carol’s bright and ambitious daughter, whose childhood goal to work in interstellar communication will evolve into something far grander.

Tracing five decades of love, loss, ambition, and self-discovery, *The Radiant Dark* is a stunning examination of a family navigating their lives with the knowledge that we are not alone.

The city of Houston does not sleep easily in July.

The heat lingers past midnight, rising from the asphalt in slow, invisible waves, settling over the bayous and the flatlands like a second skin. By the time the rest of the country has pulled on a light jacket and called the evening cool, Houston is still sweating — still exhaling the day's burn into a sky too thick and close to offer relief.

It was in this kind of heat that Donna died.

And it was in this heat that Bill first understood how quickly the world a man builds over a lifetime can be taken from him — not just the woman he loved, but the practice, the purpose, the very stability of his mind and body. All of it. Gone.

He was sixty-two years old when he buried her in his heart, because her family would not let him stand at her grave.

This is that story.

releases.title: Wings of Brotherhood
releases.synopsis:
Wings of Brotherhood: A Journey Between Two Air Forces by Badrul Hassan Khan is an extraordinary Pakistan Air Force memoir that takes readers inside the cockpit, command rooms, and corridors of power across South Asia and the Gulf. From fierce dogfights in West Pakistan during the 1965 war to the heartbreaking betrayals of 1971, this PAF pilot biography book reveals the courage, loyalty, and sacrifices of men who shaped aerial warfare in the region.

Wing Commander Badrul Hassan Khan, one of the rare officers to have fought in both the Indo Pak wars, offers an unfiltered look at how politics, pride, and patriotism collided in the skies. As he moves from the Pakistan Air Force to help build Bahrain’s Air Wing from scratch, readers witness the remarkable evolution of two nations’ military identities.

Packed with gripping battle scenes, behind the scenes accounts of Air Marshal Noor Khan’s leadership, and insider perspectives on military intelligence, this military memoir book captures a defining era of aviation and regional geopolitics. Whether you’re a history enthusiast, a student of Pakistan Air Force history, or simply drawn to tales of valor and vision, Wings of Brotherhood offers an unmatched journey through war, duty, and brotherhood.

A powerful addition to collections of books on the Indo Pak war 1965 and 1971, this is the definitive Pakistan Air Force memoir, a story of ambition, betrayal, and resilience that continues to shape South Asia’s skies.

releases.title: First Freedom
releases.synopsis:
Born in 1926, Opal Lee grew up in a racially divided America and dedicated her life to overcoming the obstacles presented therein. A lifelong educator, Ms. Opal has been a community activist all her life, and would take on the movement to celebrate and commemorate Juneteenth not just as a holiday, but as a symbol of comprehensive freedom for all people.

Ms. Opal’s life personifies the fight for everyday freedom that leads to lasting change. As the Grandmother of Juneteenth says, “There is so much more to do.”

releases.title: To Catch a Fascist
releases.synopsis:
A searing, provocative investigation into the rise of white nationalist and neo-Nazi movements in the United States, centered on the anti-fascist groups working to expose and stop these hateful factions.

Demonized as “extremist” by conservatives and liberals alike, “antifa” became a bogeyman during Donald Trump’s first term. But few Americans understood the dangerous work antifa was doing to disrupt and unmask a new generation of white supremacists or listened when antifa sounded the alarm about these white supremacists taking positions of power. Now this underground network of militant anti-fascists is determined to stop the rising tide of fascism in America. No matter the cost.

In the tradition of in-the-room investigative classics such as The Smartest Guys in the Room and Bad Blood, To Catch a Fascist follows different factions of antifascists as they work to unmask hateful extremists before they commit devastating acts of violence. With searing detail and exclusive reporting, To Catch a Fascist paints a vivid picture of the stakes in this ongoing, often unseen war between opposite ends of the political spectrum, highlighting the scrappy resourcefulness and resilience of anti-fascist movements against their increasingly violent adversaries. Utilizing razor-sharp storytelling and eye-opening insight, this timely and necessary book reveals the human cost, moral dilemmas, and unwavering determination involved in fighting white supremacy.

Both a call to action and a pulse-raising look at the powerful work being done to combat today’s gravest threat to democracy, To Catch a Fascist will inspire you to fight for your community.

releases.title: Intoxicated Ways of Knowing
releases.synopsis:
Intoxicating substances can be found lurking in every corner of modern life, and Matthew Perkins-McVey’s pathbreaking book offers the untold story of how they were implicated in shifting perceptions of embodiment found in the emerging sciences of the body and mind in late-nineteenth-century Germany. Their use in this experimental context gave rise to a dynamic conception of the subject within the scientific, psychological, philosophical, and sociological milieu of the era. The history of the modern biological subject, Perkins-McVey argues, turns on “intoxicated ways of knowing.”
 
Intoxicated Ways of Knowing identifies the state of intoxication as a tacit form of thinking and knowing with the body. Intoxicants force us to feel, intervening directly in our perceptional awareness, and, Perkins-McVey contends, they bring latent conceptual associations into the foreground of conscious thought, engendering new ways of knowing the world. The book unfurls how intoxicants affected nineteenth-century German science and how, ultimately, the connection between mental life and intoxication is taken up in the works of Friedrich Nietzsche, Max Weber, and Sigmund Freud, bringing the biological subject out of the lab and into the worlds of philosophy, psychoanalysis, sociology, and politics.

releases.title: Selecting and Appraising Archives and Manuscripts
releases.synopsis:
Today, we operate in an environment of records abundance, with far more documentation created than can reasonably be kept. Thoughtful selection and appraisal is both a balancing act and a vital skill for modern archivists. Selecting and Appraising Archives and Manuscripts is a concise introduction to the theory and practice of archival selection and appraisal, offering practical tools for principled work.

While much of the existing literature on appraisal is theoretical, this book focuses on practical ideas that are grounded in best practices, informed by the past, and aspirationally moving the profession forward. Divided into six chapters, topics include policy development, ethics and strategies for collecting repositories, tools and methods for analyzing records, appraisal and acquisition in institutional settings, and more. Guidance is centered on intentional collecting, adherence to professional values, and responsible stewardship, and covers a variety of formats.

This volume can be read in a linear way or used as a quick reference in real-life scenarios. Read it in its entirety, or jump to specific chapters as your situation warrants. This volume will help readers feel confident in making thoughtful collection- building decisions.
